paragraphs.text:
You bring the mirror to the the
walnut tree and shatter it.
Immediately, the ghosts of the
Rosens materialize from  the
shattered mirror. Seven ghosts of
children emerge from the ground
and assault them. As the nine
figures engage each other in a
ghostly melee, you feel the curse
being lifted from you, and you run
away. You turn your head one last
time as Seth Rosen screams: “You
do not understand what you have
done! Snowy Samuel! Snowy
Samuel will come and the witch
children will take your soul!”
The cries fade in the distance as
you return to your exploration.
Write the keyword SNOWY on your
play sheet.
